data.title: 伊雷娜 · 异国小镇市集
data.description: 【伊蕾娜 · 异国小镇市集】白天的石板广场上，商贩摊位摆满刚出炉的糕点与各色商品。伊蕾娜穿着熟悉的黑色魔女装，拿着新买的面包点心边走边尝，目光又被下一家摊位吸引——「尝遍当地的味道，也算旅行见闻的一部分吧。」
data.action: 穿着魔女装在市集广场品尝新鲜糕点
data.promptProse: Elaina tastes a fresh pastry in the foreign town's busy market square, confidently surveying the stalls in her black witch dress and star brooch. The medium view keeps her hands and pastry in front, several plainly clothed shoppers moving between colorful awnings farther back. Bright daylight illuminates the pastry crust and her silver hair, while awnings cast cooler bands of shade across merchandise and the square's receding paving.
